text: Despite the great volatility of hedge fund adviser returns over the observation period, the empirical evidence for a discontinuity at the $150 million AUM threshold is robust, but the discontinuity does not persist beyond the registration effective date.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Barbara Luppi, Sandra Paterlini, Did the Dodd-Frank Act Impact Hedge Fund Performance (2014). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2389416

isBasedOn.name: Did the Dodd-Frank Act Impact Hedge Fund Performance

abstract: Despite the great volatility of hedge fund adviser returns displayed over the period under examination, the empirical evidence is robust. The discontinuity is not persistent and dissipates in the subsequent months after the registration effective date for hedge fund advisers.
